title: NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions

entities.name: NR sidelink U2N Relay UE
entities.description: Operation for UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Relay functionality, involving evaluation of threshold conditions based on RSRP measurements.

entities.name: threshHighRelay
entities.description: High threshold parameter for RSRP measurement comparison, used to determine if threshold conditions are met or not.

entities.name: threshLowRelay
entities.description: Low threshold parameter for RSRP measurement comparison, used to determine if threshold conditions are met or not.

entities.name: hystMaxRelay
entities.description: Hysteresis value applied to threshHighRelay for condition evaluation.

entities.name: hystMinRelay
entities.description: Hysteresis value applied to threshLowRelay for condition evaluation.

entities.name: RSRP measurement
entities.description: Reference Signal Received Power measurement of the PCell or the camping cell, used to evaluate threshold conditions.

entities.name: Threshold conditions met (entry)
entities.description: Condition is met when RSRP is below threshHighRelay by hystMaxRelay (if configured) and above threshLowRelay by hystMinRelay (if configured), or if thresholds are not configured.

entities.name: Threshold conditions not met (leave)
entities.description: Condition is not met when RSRP is above threshHighRelay or below threshLowRelay.

relations.description: UE considers threshold conditions met (entry) when specified RSRP comparisons hold.
UE considers threshold conditions not met (leave) when RSRP is above threshHighRelay or below threshLowRelay.
Entry condition depends on threshHighRelay configuration and RSRP comparison.
Entry condition depends on threshLowRelay configuration and RSRP comparison.
Entry condition uses hystMaxRelay hysteresis with threshHighRelay.
Entry condition uses hystMinRelay hysteresis with threshLowRelay.
Leave condition is triggered if RSRP is above threshHighRelay.
Leave condition is triggered if RSRP is below threshLowRelay.
Entry condition evaluation is based on RSRP measurement of PCell or camping cell.
Leave condition evaluation is based on RSRP measurement of PCell or camping cell.
